title: Buckwheat Tagine with Yellow Lentils
description: A traditional North African stew, adapted with a French twist using buckwheat and yellow lentils.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot, and yellow bell pepper. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the yellow lentils, buckwheat groats, tagine spice mix, salt, chicken broth, and water. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils and buckwheat are tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
